title: HOW A WEB REQUEST WORKS
$voice: Voice-over is derived from the beat captions below. Default engine espeak (offline, deterministic); set NARRATE_ENGINE=elevenlabs to upgrade the voice.

beats.caption: You type an address. A lot happens in the next 200 milliseconds.
First: DNS. The name shop.example is looked up and becomes an IP address.
Your browser opens a connection and performs the TLS handshake — everything from here is encrypted.
Now the actual request: a few lines of text asking for /checkout.
The server does its work — queries the database, builds the response.
The response streams back, and the browser paints your page. All of it — faster than a blink.
